newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Construction Holdings FRN doubled.
newsitem.headline: China Construction Holdings FRN doubled.

text.p: China Construction Holdings' three-year floating rate note issue has been doubled to US$60 million from US$30 million after being oversubscribed in syndication, bankers said on Monday.
The notes were launched at par to float at 200 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate. With fees, the all-in return to top-tier managers is 225 basis points.
The issue was oversubscribed to US$160 million but commitments were scaled back. Thirty-five banks participated in the transaction.
BA Asia and KorAm Bank were arrangers and bookrunners.
